title: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive — Athens and Sparta, 26–27 September, 2015–2025
claims: For Athens, the 26–27 September window in 2015–2025 contains 22 daily records: daily maximum 19.7–30.0 °C (median 25.3 °C), daily minimum 13.9–20.5 °C (median 17.6 °C), 6 days with at least 1 mm precipitation and 2 days with at least 5 mm.

For Sparta, the same window contains 22 daily records: daily maximum 19.6–32.3 °C (median 26.6 °C), daily minimum 11.6–18.6 °C (median 15.9 °C), 4 days with at least 1 mm precipitation and 2 days with at least 5 mm.
The two stations are valley/coastal stations; the course crosses the Sangas Pass at about 1,100 m, where conditions can differ from both cities.

verification.note: Daily values retrieved for Athens and Sparta and filtered to 26–27 September; medians and wet-day counts calculated locally.

claimVerification.note: Coordinates from API; pass elevation from official route page.
